title: What companies planned to spend on AI
subtitle: Survey illustration comparing planned and reported spending against the 2025 baseline.

annotation.note: The reported mean was higher than the reported median.

alt_text: Two horizontal rows share a scale of zero to five times 2025 spending. Mean planned 1.9× and reported 4.7×. Median planned 1.8× and reported 2.2×. Values are self-reported.
